sourceRefs.locator: Introduction, Figures 1 and 2, Table 1, “General characteristics” and reconstruction. Site plan, location of cargo and crew items, cherries and coin, calibrated timber dates, reconstructed dimensions.

Shipwrecks Database, entry 997: site-level coordinates 41.00447° N, 28.95249° E for Yenikapı. The point locates the excavation area, not the individual hull.

note.de: Münze und Amphoren stützen die Datierung des Wracks YK 12 ins neunte Jahrhundert. Der Punkt markiert das Ausgrabungsgebiet im Hafen.
